digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface — config ownership cutover
propositions: 12 below-seam ambient config reads in the reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface are flagged as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS: JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT (composition-owner, non-secret) and REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in 6 source files must be moved to owned resolvers or marked in-place.

11 of 12 composed-config reads (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, acli timeout, datacenter settings, rich_text/wiki_render knobs) must be cut-to-seam through owned config.py/config_sources.py resolvers so they resolve live per call with env-over-file precedence, not ambient below the gate.
1 read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE) must be marked inline with a # read-via: comment and NOT routed through a resolver, keeping the subsystem debug switch in-place and out-of-schema.

All LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows for the 6 affected files must be deleted and the gate check_config_ownership.py must pass with zero findings; a held-out oracle asserts marker-total==1 and confined placement.

The secret reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) remain owned in-boundary; env/file precedence, defaults, fail-loud/degrade behaviors, and timestamp-invariant ImportError fallbacks are byte-preserved across the cutover.
